language.description: Narration language: "en" (default, Kokoro voice) or "ar" (Modern Standard Arabic, SILMA voice). "ar" also mirrors every layout right to left. Arabic narration must be fully vowelled (tashkeel), with numbers written as words and no Latin letters

mode.description: "2d" (default) or "3d": every scene is drawn in 3D (WebGL), with depth used for meaning (staircases, terraces, stacks); allows the 3D-only layers3d type. continues is not supported in 3D; graph direction is ignored (3D graphs always recede into depth)

theme.description: Visual theme: "cel-sky" (2.5D cel-shaded sky, default) or "paper" (flat neo-brutalist dotted paper)

layout.description: Layout: absent = automatic (the whiteboard whenever the script allows it, else slides); "whiteboard" = hand-drawn board (strokes, underlines and check marks drawn on in time with the narration; no title bar, counter or slide transitions), an error if the script cannot use it; "slides" = title bar, counter, boxed captions and slide transitions. The board needs English, 2D, the paper theme, and no chapter or continues. title, bullets, flow, steps, fanout, compare and callout are drawn by hand, every other 2D type is shown on the board in a sketched, hand-lettered style

style.description: Audience/purpose style (explainer.py styles lists them;). Sets default speed, scene and length bounds, narration lints and what a fact ledger must cover. Absent = "explainer"

id.description: Unique within the script, e.g. s01

narration.description: What the voice says: short sentences, 15 to 60 words

cues.description: Optional, one per revealed item (bullet, step, row, node, message, ...): a word or phrase from the narration at which that item should appear. Use "" to leave an item automatic. Only needed when automatic matching places an item wrongly. In a scene with "continues", only the new items count

focus.description: graph, class, sequence, svg, timeline, stat and mermaid only: point at parts already on screen as the narration talks about them (for mermaid: node ids or labels as drawn, or "from->to" for a line between them)

at.description: Word or phrase from the narration, spoken when the focus should change; focus entries follow the narration order

on.description: What to bring forward from then on: node, class, participant, svg part, timeline event or stat ids, or "from->to" for an edge, relation or message. Everything else is dimmed (a crowded diagram also zooms in). [] ends the focus

continues.description: graph, class and sequence only: this scene carries on the previous scene's diagram (same type, shared ids). Shared parts stay on screen and move to their new places, only new ones are revealed. List the full diagram again

chapter.description: Optional chapter card shown via @remotion/transitions before this scene when starting a new part (not allowed with continues)

facts.description: Styles with a fact ledger (style flag): ids of the ledger.json facts this scene covers; check fails when a required fact is in no scene

section.description: Styles: which part of the style's structure this scene is (one of the style's sections, e.g. "decisions"); optional

id.description: Unique layer id

sub.description: One short line under the label

layers.description: Layers bottom to top, revealed in this order over the narration

oneOf.description: 3D only (needs "mode": "3d"): an architecture drawn as stacked 3D slabs, bottom layer first

expr.description: Safe math expression z = f(x, y)

grid.description: Explicit rectangular height grid grid[iy][ix] (2..32 per side)

axis.description: Fix x=at or y=at to expose partial-derivative curve

oneOf.description: 3D height surface z = f(x, y) with partial-derivative slices, tangent planes, and Riemann volume columns/voxels (3D mode only)

kicker.description: Small uppercase line above the headline

headline.description: Main headline; keep under about 35 characters

oneOf.description: Opening scene

items.description: Bullets, revealed as they are spoken; 6 or fewer fit well

oneOf.description: A short list
Side-by-side comparison

active.description: Zero-based index of the highlighted step, fixed for the whole scene; must be < items.length. Omit it to let the highlight advance with the narration (step i lights up when it is spoken), which is right when one scene narrates several steps

oneOf.description: A sequence with one highlighted step (fixed, or advancing with the narration)

nodes.description: 2 to 5 boxes joined by arrows, left to right

oneOf.description: A short left-to-right chain
One source routing to 1 to 4 targets

rows.description: Each row needs exactly one cell per header

oneOf.description: A small table

tone.description: "warn" for a warning or open question

oneOf.description: One key message

code.description: Mermaid source (newlines as \n). Use for sequence, state, ER, class and similar diagrams; use "graph" for plain node-and-edge diagrams

build.description: Draw the diagram up as the narration names its parts (nodes, states, entities, tasks, events, slices, messages); lines follow once both ends are there. Without it the whole diagram appears at once

oneOf.description: A mermaid diagram, pre-rendered to SVG

direction.description: Layout direction: LR left to right (default), TB top to bottom

id.description: Unique id used by edges

label.description: Node title, three words or fewer

tone.description: Colour: neutral (default), primary (yellow), secondary (pink), accent (green), danger (red)

nodes.description: Revealed in this order, spread over the narration; list them in the order you speak them

dashed.description: Dashed line, for optional or indirect links

tone.description: Colours the edge label and its travelling dots, e.g. accent for the valid path and danger for the failure path; defaults to the source node colour

edges.description: Directed edges; the graph must be acyclic (no loops back). An edge appears once both of its nodes are visible

animate.description: Dots travel along the edges once they appear (default true); false for static lines

oneOf.description: A node-and-edge diagram drawn with React Flow and laid out automatically

id.description: Unique id used by messages

sub.description: Small text under the name, e.g. its role

to.description: Id of the receiver; the same id draws a self-call

messages.description: Messages top to bottom, revealed in this order over the narration

animate.description: Dots travel along each message arrow (default true)

oneOf.description: A sequence diagram drawn natively and animated: who sends what to whom, in order

direction.description: Layout direction; TB (default) puts parents on top

id.description: Unique id used by relations

stereotype.description: Shown above the name, e.g. interface or record

attributes.description: Attribute lines, 34 characters or fewer each, e.g. "code_challenge: string"

methods.description: Method lines, 34 characters or fewer each, e.g. "verify(verifier)"

classes.description: Classes, revealed in this order over the narration

from.description: Id of the source class. For inherits/implements this is the child; for composes/aggregates the whole

to.description: Id of the target class. For inherits/implements this is the parent; for composes/aggregates the part

type.description: inherits (solid, hollow triangle), implements (dashed, hollow triangle), composes (filled diamond), aggregates (hollow diamond), associates (arrow), depends (dashed arrow)

label.description: Short text on the line, e.g. "creates"

oneOf.description: A UML class diagram drawn with React Flow: classes with attributes and methods, and relations

id.description: Id of one top-level <g id="..."> in the markup; the group is that part

label.description: What the part shows, in words the narration says: the part appears when they are spoken

parts.description: The parts, in the order the narration reaches them; each is a top-level <g id> of the svg and appears when its label is spoken. Everything outside these groups is drawn from the first frame

svg.description: Markup of one <svg viewBox="0 0 1700 560"> in a strict subset: svg g rect circle ellipse line polyline polygon path text tspan; colours, fonts and sizes are names (see SKILL.md); anything else is rejected, not stripped. At most 24 KB

oneOf.description: A drawing the model writes as SVG (strict subset), revealed part by part as the narration names them; 2D only

id.description: Optional id, only so a scene `focus` can name this event; unique within the timeline

at.description: When it happened, exactly as written in the source (e.g. "14:02 UTC", "Day 3"); shown as is, never reformatted

label.description: What happened, in words the narration says: the event appears when they are spoken

detail.description: A line of extra context under the label

status.description: How sure the source is: "confirmed", "reported" (second-hand) or "unknown". Shown as a text tag; omit when it does not matter

marker.description: A milestone badge: "detected", "mitigated", "resolved" or "impact"; "none" or omitted for a plain event

events.description: Events in time order, each appearing when its label is spoken; up to 5 are laid out on a horizontal rail, more on a vertical one

oneOf.description: A chronological sequence of dated events (incident timelines, histories); 2D only

language.description: Colouring: ts, tsx, js, jsx, python, go, rust, java, sql, bash, json, yaml, diff, or "text" for none

code.description: The code, shown as written: at most 30 lines of 80 display cells (East Asian wide characters and emoji count 2) and 2400 characters excluding line breaks, indented with spaces (no tabs), no leading or trailing blank lines, no invisible or direction-changing characters. Never trimmed: too much is an error

lines.description: The lines to point at: "4" or "4-6" (1-based, inclusive, within the code; ranges may overlap or repeat)

label.description: What this part does, in words the narration says: the highlight moves here when they are spoken

highlights.description: Parts to point at, each taking the spotlight when its label is spoken

oneOf.description: A code excerpt with syntax colouring and a spotlight that moves as the narration names its parts; 2D only

id.description: Optional id, only so a scene `focus` can name this stat; unique within the scene

label.description: What is measured, in words the narration says (the stat appears when they are spoken); at most 40 display cells, one line

value.description: The number shown, counted up to; finite, at most 1e12 in size; 0 or more when `from` is set

unit.description: Shown after the number: "%", "ms", "req/s", "USD" (a suffix only; at most 12 characters). Stats with bars share one scale only when their units match

decimals.description: Decimal places shown on every frame (0 to 4); default: as many as `value` and `from` have. Never rounds: a value with more places is an error

from.description: Earlier value: the counter runs from it to `value`, with before/after bars and a percent-change chip; 0 or more

max.description: With `from`: the end of the bar axis (e.g. 100 for a percentage); at least from and value

better.description: With `from`: which direction is good ("down" for latency or errors, "up" for throughput); the change is named better or worse

tone.description: Overrides the tone from `better`; on a plain stat, a "good" or "bad" tag

stats.description: 1 to 4 headline numbers, each appearing (and counting up) when its label is spoken; 1 or 2 are big tiles, 3 or 4 a row

oneOf.description: One to four headline numbers that count up, optionally before/after with bars and a percent change; 2D only, English only

id.description: Optional id so `focus` can highlight this curve

label.description: Shown in the legend and used for narration reveal when no stages are set

expr.description: Safe math expression in x, e.g. "0.5 * x^2" or "sin(x)"

points.description: Explicit [x, y] points with strictly increasing x (2 to 200 points)

dashed.description: Draw dashed line instead of solid

stages.description: Optional narration-timed stages (point, secant, tangent, riemann, zoom)

tag.description: Optional short callout tag next to point

toDx.description: Target step dx at end of stage (may be 0 to converge to tangent)

zoom.description: Optional camera zoom factor around (x, f(x))
Optional camera zoom factor around (x, f(x))

range.description: [a, b] integration interval with a < b

toSlices.description: Target rectangle count at end of stage (1..64)

method.description: Sampling rule or "smooth" continuous signed area

caption.description: Optional caption line under the plot

oneOf.description: Animated 2D function plot with curves, secant-to-tangent zoom, corner detection, and Riemann slices (2D only)

yDomain.description: [yMin, yMax] vertical domain for this panel

expr.description: Safe math expression in x; omit on one panel to derive it automatically from the other

top.description: Accumulation panel F(x): tangent slope matches bottom panel value

yDomain.description: [yMin, yMax] vertical domain for this panel

expr.description: Safe math expression in x; omit on one panel to derive it automatically from the other

bottom.description: Rate panel f(x) = F'(x): shaded area matches top panel height change

anchor.description: Optional integration anchor {x, y} when top F(x) is derived from bottom f(x) (default F(xMin) = 0)

label.description: Stage label matched to narration (cursor moves to stage.x when spoken)

note.description: Optional short annotation shown on the bridge bar

caption.description: Optional caption line under the plots

oneOf.description: Dual stacked synchronized plots: top tangent slope equals bottom height, bottom shaded area equals top change (2D only)

theorem.description: ftc-1d (1D telescoping), curl-2d (Green/Stokes), divergence-2d, or divergence-3d (isometric cells)

rows.description: Subdivisions along y (2D: 2..4; 3D: 2..3; omitted in ftc-1d)

note.description: Optional short explanation badge for this stage

oneOf.description: Interior-cancellation tessellations showing how opposing interior contributions cancel to leave only the outer boundary (2D only)

expr.description: Scalar mode: safe math expression f(x, y)

fx.description: Vector mode: x-component expression Fx(x, y)

fy.description: Vector mode: y-component expression Fy(x, y)

particles.description: Vector mode: animate deterministic advected particles (default true)

axis.description: Fix x=at (vary y) or y=at (vary x)

oneOf.description: 2D scalar contour map or vector field with narration-timed multivariable calculus overlays (2D only)

kind.description: Empirical chart mode: benchmark bar, scaling line, or Pareto scatter

layout.description: For kind="bar": vertical grouped bars (default) or horizontal bars

unit.description: Optional metric unit suffix shown on bar labels (e.g. "%", "ms")

categories.description: For kind="bar": benchmark or dataset names along the category axis (1..8)

series.description: For kind="bar" or kind="line": data series (1..8)

id.description: Optional id so `focus` can highlight this series

label.description: Series or method legend label (40 display cells max)

values.description: For kind="bar": one numeric value per category

errors.description: For kind="bar": optional symmetric ± half-width error bar per category

ci.description: For kind="bar": optional [low, high] confidence interval per category

points.description: For kind="line": sorted [x, y] points with strictly increasing x (2..100)

band.description: For kind="line": optional [low, high] variance band matching points length

highlight.description: Emphasize proposed method or primary curve

id.description: Optional id so `focus` can highlight this point

label.description: Point / method label (40 display cells max)

highlight.description: Emphasize this point with a callout halo

betterX.description: For kind="scatter": optimal X direction for Pareto frontier (default "min")

betterY.description: For kind="scatter": optimal Y direction for Pareto frontier (default "max")

showFrontier.description: For kind="scatter": draw the computed Pareto frontier line (default true)

baseline.description: Optional reference threshold line across the value axis

higherIsBetter.description: True (default) if positive deltas are gains; false for loss/latency metrics

id.description: Optional id so `focus` can highlight the baseline bar

label.description: Shown under the starting bar and used as its reveal slot

id.description: Optional id so `focus` can highlight this component step

label.description: Shown below this bar and matched in narration for timing

delta.description: Signed contribution (+ or -) added to running total

showTotal.description: Whether to append the cumulative final bar (default true)

totalId.description: Optional id so `focus` can highlight the final total bar

values.description: 2D grid of numeric intensities matching rows.length x cols.length

rowLabel.description: Optional Y/row axis tensor annotation (e.g. "Query Token")

colLabel.description: Optional X/column axis tensor annotation (e.g. "Key Token")

decimals.description: Optional fixed decimal places for cell numbers

showValues.description: Show numeric values inside cells (default true)

highlights.description: Optional narration-timed highlights over rows, columns, cells, or blocks

id.description: Optional id so `focus` can highlight this region

label.description: Highlight / reveal slot label (matched in narration)

tone.description: Highlight frame colour token from theme

equations.description: 1 or 2 load-bearing LaTeX equations with \term{id}{...} spans

id.description: Term id matching a \term{id}{...} span in the equation

label.description: Spotlight timing slot matched against narration

gloss.description: Plain-English explanation displayed below while this term is spotlighted

tone.description: Spotlight highlight colour token from theme

terms.description: Ordered term spotlights and plain-English glosses (1..8)

src.description: Relative POSIX path inside <workdir> to a PNG, JPG/JPEG, or SVG file

alt.description: Short figure description (also fallback reveal slot when no regions are listed)

regions.description: Optional narration-timed callout bounding boxes (1..6) with zoom & dim-outside spotlight

id.description: Optional id so `focus` can spotlight this region directly

label.description: Region / callout label matched in narration (36 display cells max)

zoom.description: Optional zoom factor when spotlighting this region (1..3.5)

tone.description: Highlight bounding box colour token from theme

note.description: Optional short plain-English annotation shown while spotlighted

mode.description: "cells" (default) for indexed boxes, "bars" for sorting heights

showIndices.description: Whether to render 0-based index labels below slots (default true)

id.description: Optional step ID for `focus`

label.description: Step label spoken in narration (aligns reveal timing)

id.description: Stable element ID across steps so swaps and moves animate smoothly

anyOf.description: Short value shown inside the cell

state.description: Semantic highlight state for this element

subLabel.description: Optional short sub-label inside cell mode

name.description: Pointer label (e.g. L, R, i, j, pivot)

label.description: Auxiliary strip title (e.g. Stack, Best, Pivot)

note.description: Optional short invariant or complexity note

directed.description: Whether edges draw arrowheads by default (default false)

id.description: Unique node ID referenced by edges and step state maps

label.description: Short node label (e.g. A, S, v0, 42)

id.description: Optional explicit edge ID for edgeStates and focus

anyOf.description: Short edge weight or capacity label

id.description: Optional step ID for `focus`

label.description: Step label spoken in narration (aligns reveal timing)

nodeStates.description: Map of node ID -> semantic state tone

additionalProperties.description: Short badge pill above node (e.g. d=4, L1)

edgeStates.description: Map of edge key (`edge.id` or `"from->to"`) -> semantic tone

label.description: Auxiliary strip title (e.g. Queue, Priority Q, Stack)

note.description: Optional short invariant or complexity note

visual.description: Built-in visual types; "type" selects the shape

scenes.description: Scenes in play order; one idea each
